item.description:
What's new in Konpo 1.2

Keyboard

  • J — Jump to file: type a few letters of any track in your music folder and press Return to play it.
  • Q / ⇧Q — add the selected track, folder or album to Up Next, or play it next. Up Next shows in the art panel; drag to reorder.
  • S / R — shuffle and repeat (off / all / one).
  • T — show time remaining instead of track length (or click the time).
  • ⇧⌘R — reveal the selected track, folder or album in Finder.
  • Winamp keys — turn on Z X C V B for previous / play / pause / stop / next in Settings.

Winamp tribute

  • Mini player (⌥⌘M) — a slim floating bar with a scrolling title.
  • Equalizer (⇧⌘E) — 10 bands, presets, and your own saved presets.
  • Spectrum — optional little analyzer bars next to the title (click for a scope).

For music kept as files

  • ReplayGain — evens out loudness using the tags already in your files, by track or album.
  • CUE sheets — single-file albums with a .cue show as separate tracks, played gaplessly.
  • New music shows up on its own — Konpo watches your music folder for changes.
  • M3U playlists — import and export.
  • Picks up where you left off — reopens your last track at the same spot, paused.

Settings now has Appearance, Playback and Updates tabs.
